changes.text: First 2027 line-up wave added by hand (97 acts). Headliners: blink-182, Bring Me The Horizon, Evanescence; also Faith No More, The Prodigy, Mötley Crüe, Parkway Drive, Kreator, Orbit Culture. festivalhopper.de had not listed it yet.
2027 4-day ticket price added: DKK 2,810 incl. fee (≈ €377). R.I.P. 4-day DKK 3,985.
Added Rock am Ring / Rock im Park, Tons of Rock, Rock Fest Barcelona, Mystic, Rockharz, Masters of Rock, Leyendas del Rock and Motocultor. (Metaldays was checked and left out: it closed in 2024.)
